title: Mailbox/query uses EmailFilter as Mailbox filter type — wrong type in trait impl
description: backend.rs:638-643: QueryObject for Mailbox uses EmailFilter as the Filter type with a comment saying Mailbox/query has no defined filter type. But Mailbox/query DOES have defined filter fields (parentId, name, role, hasAnyRole, isSubscribed per RFC 8621 §2.3). The handler (mailbox.rs) hand-parses these fields from the raw args rather than using the trait Filter type. Backend implementors who override query_objects::<Mailbox> will receive an EmailFilter object, which is confusing and incorrect. Should define a MailboxFilterCondition type.
